title: metravel map filter intent
description: What the assistant produces from a question like «где рядом с Несвижем смотровые и парковка для кемпера»: the map's POI filter. categories mirror OsmPoiCategory in utils/overpass/buildOverpassQuery.ts, radius_km mirrors RADIUS_OPTIONS in constants/mapConfig.ts (guarded by __tests__/scripts/ai-train-osm-filter-schema.test.ts); center is a place name the map geocodes, or null for the whole country; constraints are the visitor's wishes the map applies on top of the categories. One schema for the training set (sets/osm_intents.py), the eval slice (eval.py expect=json) and, later, the assistant.
